title: Barrel Shop Vanilla
description: The plugin allows players to create barrel shops and sell items for other items!
body:
The plugin allows players to create barrel shops and set prices for items inside them. It protects against griefing and theft of these items, as well as against explosions and hopper damage. Players can also choose any items they want to trade for selling items. 

The plugin is highly vanilla-friendly and does not add any custom menus. It is suitable for vanilla and SMP servers.



Guide
Creating a shop

    Look at a barrel.
    Use the command:
    /createshop <price> <payment item (diamonds by default)>

Example:

/createshop 5 diamond


This creates a barrel shop where players must pay 5 diamonds for each item they take.


Selling items

After creating the shop, simply put the items you want to sell into the barrel.


Players must have the required payment items in their inventory to purchase anything from the shop.


Buying items

To buy an item:


    Open the barrel shop
    Click on any item you want to purchase

If you have enough payment items in your inventory, the trade will be completed automatically.


Protection

    Only the barrel owner or a player with OP can break the barrel shop.
    Players with OP see barrel shops as normal barrels and can freely take, place, or move items inside them.
    Barrel shops are fully protected from griefing.
